name: com.invelon.unity-utilities
description: A collection of standalone Unity Editor tools and utilities: MissingScriptsFinder (find/delete missing scripts in scenes and prefabs), SceneSwitcher (quick-switch scenes from an Editor window), BuildTools/VRGameBuilder (META Quest / PICO Android build pipeline with OpenXR profile switching), MRSetup/MRPlatformConfigurator (Meta Quest / PICO OpenXR passthrough configuration switcher), and PackageManifestInstaller (one-click UPM dependency installer). Each tool folder is also its own self-contained UPM package — see AGENTS.md for the structure.
